groups.rationale: Antithesis workload-only: the Enrico ninth-admission oracle polls for its pre-admission holder witness instead of reading the periodic observer snapshot once, and keeps evaluating the ownership bound when the ninth case is unexercised; no SUT, scope or documented boundary change.
